title.en: One window only: When does a building use the Electric 30 fine-stone row
title.zh: 只留一个窗口：建筑浇筑什么时候读电动30的细石行

description.en: Keep this cell as published. Use the Electric 30 fine-stone cells when the mix is the fine-stone line Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints in Xingtai: horizontal 60 m and vertical 180 m, beside 30 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa and hopper 0.3 m³. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The same page prints a second distance for aggregate 13: 20 m / 60 m, and maximum aggregate ≤ 3 cm. Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not paste the 180 m vertical figure onto the coarser row.
description.zh: 料属于邢台河北品锦机械印出的细石行时，才用电动30的细石格：水平 60 m、垂直 180 m，旁边是 30 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³。同一页给 13 骨料另印了 20 m / 60 m，最大骨料 ≤ 3 cm。先不要把 180 m 垂直抄到较粗的那一行。

h1.en: One window only: When does a building use the Electric 30 fine-stone row
h1.zh: 只留一个窗口：建筑浇筑什么时候读电动30的细石行

directAnswer.en: Keep this cell as published. Use the Electric 30 fine-stone cells when the mix is the fine-stone line Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints in Xingtai: horizontal 60 m and vertical 180 m, beside 30 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa and hopper 0.3 m³. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The same page prints a second distance for aggregate 13: 20 m / 60 m, and maximum aggregate ≤ 3 cm. Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not paste the 180 m vertical figure onto the coarser row.
directAnswer.zh: 料属于邢台河北品锦机械印出的细石行时，才用电动30的细石格：水平 60 m、垂直 180 m，旁边是 30 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³。同一页给 13 骨料另印了 20 m / 60 m，最大骨料 ≤ 3 cm。先不要把 180 m 垂直抄到较粗的那一行。

body.en: Borrow “History” from “Quarry” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Keep this cell as published. Read Electric 30 fine stone only for that printed line: 30 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, horizontal 60 m / vertical 180 m. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The table separates “fine stone pumping” from “aggregate 13 pumping”. Read it in the Xingtai table. Building placement is the published scenario, not a named tower. Taken from the printed row: Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Keep this cell as published. No. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quarry
body.zh: 把《Quarry》的“沿革”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。这一格照已印出的读：只有料对得上细石行才读电动30：30 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、水平 60 m / 垂直 180 m。13 骨料行更短。旁边那一台不在这句话里。请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。图来自来源页面：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quarry

body.en: The reference page “Quarry” uses “Stone industry” as one of its own divisions. What follows is the Xingtai row, said again in different words. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The aggregate-13 line is shorter. Read it in the Xingtai table. Fine stone is 60 m horizontal / 180 m vertical. Taken from the printed row: Open the aggregate-13 row, or leave Electric 30 if the stone is above ≤ 3 cm. Keep this cell as published. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. It is an electric trailer pump.
body.zh: 来源页《Quarry》用“石料”划分这一节。后面是邢台目录里已有内容，换一种说法写下。旁边那一台不在这句话里。料属于邢台河北品锦机械印出的细石行时，才用电动30的细石格：水平 60 m、垂直 180 m，旁边是 30 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³。同一页给 13 骨料另印了 20 m / 60 m，最大骨料 ≤ 3 cm。不要把 180 m 垂直抄到较粗的那一行。按邢台表上的原文理解：不可以。13 骨料印的是 20 m / 60 m。

body.en: “Types of rock” is an outline label from “Quarry”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. Read it in the Xingtai table. Use the Electric 30 fine-stone cells when the mix is the fine-stone line Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints in Xingtai: horizontal 60 m and vertical 180 m, beside 30 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa and hopper 0.3 m³. Taken from the printed row: Aggregate 13 is 20 m horizontal / 60 m vertical. Keep this cell as published. Electric Low Pressure 40 prints a fine-stone window of 80 m / 240 m at the same 12–15 m³/h and 20 MPa, with a 37 kW motor, and it does not print an aggregate-13 distance. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. Read it in the Xingtai table. Spraying machines are on /products/spraying-machines.
body.zh: “分型岩”是《Quarry》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。按邢台表上的原文理解：表把“细石输送”和“13 骨料输送”分开。细石是水平 60 m / 垂直 180 m。13 骨料是水平 20 m / 垂直 60 m。两行共用 12–15 m³/h 和 20 MPa。机架是 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm、1200 kg。公布工况是建筑浇筑，不是一座有名字的楼。目录里已经写着：不是。它是电动拖泵。喷涂机在 /products/spraying-machines。

body.en: This block keeps the heading “Methods of quarrying” from “Quarry”, then stays with the cells already published. Taken from the printed row: The same page prints a second distance for aggregate 13: 20 m / 60 m, and maximum aggregate ≤ 3 cm. Keep this cell as published. Both sit under the same 12–15 m³/h and 20 MPa cells. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Do not invent that second row. Read it in the Xingtai table. No. Taken from the printed row: No.
body.zh: 本节保留《Quarry》的标题“工法”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。目录里已经写着：去读 13 骨料行；石子超过 ≤ 3 cm 就离开电动30。电动低压40在同样的 12–15 m³/h 和 20 MPa 下，细石窗口是 80 m / 240 m，电机 37 kW，并且没有印 13 骨料距离。不要替它编第二行。这一格照已印出的读：没有。12–15 m³/h 是目录输送量格。

body.en: The section shape comes from “Slabs” in “Quarry”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Keep this cell as published. Do not paste the 180 m vertical figure onto the coarser row. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The machine frame is 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. Write “fine stone” or “aggregate 13”, plus the measured horizontal and vertical metres. Taken from the printed row: Aggregate 13 is printed as 20 m / 60 m. Keep this cell as published. 12–15 m³/h is the catalogue output cell.
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Quarry》的“板”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。这一格照已印出的读：请写明是“细石”还是“13 骨料”，并附上量到的水平与垂直米数。

question.en: Under “History”, can the 180 m vertical cell be used for aggregate 13?
question.zh: 在“沿革”这一节里，180 m 垂直可以用于 13 骨料吗？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. No. Aggregate 13 is printed as 20 m / 60 m.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：不可以。13 骨料印的是 20 m / 60 m。

question.en: What should stay printed beside “Stone industry” — Is Electric 30 a spraying machine?
question.zh: “石料”旁边仍要印着的是什么：电动30是喷涂机吗？

answer.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. It is an electric trailer pump. Spraying machines are on /products/spraying-machines.
answer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。不是。它是电动拖泵。喷涂机在 /products/spraying-machines。

question.en: “Types of rock” does not change the check: Does the page list a jobsite volume?
question.zh: “分型岩”不改这一问：这一页有工地方量吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. No. 12–15 m³/h is the catalogue output cell.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：没有。12–15 m³/h 是目录输送量格。
